index.title: Automatic Labeling Tool
index.model_location_desc: Select the model used for WD image tagging. Models are discovered under Model Root/wd; tag coverage, speed, and resource usage vary by model.
index.threshold_desc:
The higher the threshold, the fewer labels are generated, but the accuracy of the labels is higher.
The lower the threshold, the more labels are generated, but the accuracy of the labels decreases.
index.batch_size_desc: It is recommended that the number of images processed in each batch should not be too large.
index.filter_tags_desc: Filtered tags will not be written to the tag group in the file.
index.filter_tags_palceholder: Enter the filter tags (in English), then press Enter to confirm.
index.is_overwrite_desc:
Do not overwrite: Directly skip files that already have tags (this is the fastest option if many files already have tags).
Overwrite: If a tag exists, it will be overwritten (this process is time-consuming).
Merging: Merging will be performed if there are labels (this is the most time-consuming process).
index.read_video_desc:
The video content will be read, and image recognition will be performed on the frames at 1%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 99% of the video duration.
The speed of tagging video files will be significantly reduced.
You need to install ffmpeg from the plugin center beforehand.
index.no_read_video: Do not read the video content
index.label_language_desc: Controls the language of tags written to Eagle. Chinese uses the built-in tag translations; Chinese + English keeps tags in both languages.
index.splitter_desc: The separator is only needed when both Chinese and English labels are present.
index.splitter_palceholder_mix: The separator is only needed when both Chinese and English labels are present.
index.threshold_hint: Recommended: 0.35 for WD models and 0.75 for CL/CA models
index.model_directory_missing: The selected WD model directory could not be located; tagging was cancelled

semantic_search.model_desc: Select the model that creates image and text vectors. Only vectors from the same model, protocol, and dimension are comparable. Each model uses an independent index.
semantic_search.batch_size_desc: Number of images sent to the local inference engine at once. Larger batches are usually faster but consume more RAM or VRAM.
semantic_search.concurrency_desc: Number of images uploaded to a remote embedding service at the same time. Higher concurrency can index faster, but uses more bandwidth and memory and may trigger provider rate limits.
semantic_search.search_mode_desc: Text mode converts your description into a vector. Current Image mode reads the single image selected in Eagle and finds the most visually similar items.
semantic_search.remote_host_placeholder: Leave empty to use default HuggingFace
semantic_search.query_desc: Describe the subject, scene, colors, or style you want to find. Specific, direct descriptions are usually more reliable than a loose list of keywords.

settings.model_location_desc: Root directory used for models and the semantic index. WD, LLM, Embedding, and llamafile resources use separate subfolders beneath it.
settings.llm_runner_desc: Executable used for local LLM inference. Leave empty to use the downloaded runner under Model Root/llamafile, or select a file to override it.
settings.llm_runner_placeholder: Leave empty to use the downloaded program under model root/llamafile
settings.llamafile_downloaded: llamafile downloaded and runner path saved
settings.llm_gpu_backend_desc: Auto probes CUDA, Metal, then Vulkan and uses CPU when none are available. Select a backend explicitly to diagnose driver or runtime problems.
settings.llm_gpu_fallback_desc: Tries Vulkan and CPU only when the log confirms that the selected GPU backend is unavailable. Model, port, and out-of-memory errors are still reported.
settings.remote_llm_select: Select a remote LLM to edit
settings.remote_llm_name_placeholder: For example Primary or Backup Relay
settings.remote_embedding_name_placeholder: For example Primary or Backup Relay
settings.embedding_endpoint_desc: Enter only the service base URL. OpenAI Compatible appends /v1/embeddings; Native Gemini REST appends the matching v1beta model path.
settings.embedding_api_key_desc: Authentication key for the remote embedding service. It is encrypted through the operating-system credential store and is not written to JSON5 in plain text.
settings.embedding_model_name_desc: Enter the exact model identifier exposed by the remote service. Different model identifiers use separate vector tables.
settings.embedding_provider_desc: Select the request format used by the remote service. OpenAI Compatible uses the embeddings endpoint; Native Gemini REST supports Gemini image/text embeddings and output dimensions.
settings.embedding_dimension_desc: Controls Gemini vector length from 128 to 3072; 1536 is recommended. Vectors with different dimensions are incompatible and use separate indexes.
